## COLOR\_STYLE\_GROUPS variable

The color styles grouped for a picker: which alphabet each group applies to (`null` for the analysis group, which works on any alignment).

**Signature:**

```typescript
COLOR_STYLE_GROUPS: {
    label: string;
    styles: ColorStyle[];
    type: SequenceType | null;
}[]
```
